about:
MHz Electronics, Inc. is based in Phoenix, Arizona. The company has been buying and selling electronic manufacturing equipment, testing tools, and specialty items for over 35 years. In 1997, it moved to its current 68,000-square-foot facility on East Washington Avenue.

The company operates as a distributor and reseller of electronic components, test equipment, and specialty items. Its inventory exceeds 400,000 parts and equipment, housed in a 68,000-square-foot warehouse that has supported the company’s growth since 1997. MHz Electronics also offers a sourcing service for items not in stock and maintains a want list for customers looking to sell equipment.

The company serves buyers of electronic manufacturing equipment, test instruments, and specialty components across the western United States, with a focus on customers needing hard-to-find or obsolete parts.

MHz Electronics distinguishes itself as the largest in-stock supplier of test equipment in the western United States and emphasizes a sourcing service for hard-to-find items, backed by over three decades of industry experience.
